scheme: ECC-based secure clustering with pairwise key establishment (gateway-based heterogeneous WSN)
mechanism: Tamper-proof gateways act as fixed CHs; ECDSA-signed gateway broadcasts; cluster admission encrypted under the gateway public key; pairwise symmetric keys distributed to one-hop neighbors; revocation of misbehaving nodes
props: C yes / I yes / A yes / R (yes) node capture, revocation; not selfish nodes / P no
threat: Adversary present from deployment; can record or alter messages and capture sensors (all keys exposed); gateways assumed tamper-proof
overhead: Public-key operations at admission; key storage ("1,002 keys" per gateway); memory "saves almost 57%" vs a probabilistic pre-distribution scheme; no energy or lifetime figures
evidence: A + S (QualNet; memory and connectivity only)
limitations: Fixed gateway CHs required; no energy, throughput or lifetime evaluation; security of ordinary sensors rests on gateway integrity

scheme: EGSCFO: evolutionary-game CH election with fuzzy trust and outlier detection (also in the game-theoretic family table)
mechanism: Interval type-2 fuzzy trust from overheard dropping/delaying rates; K-means outlier detection isolates low-trust nodes from the CH role; evolutionary game sets the self-election probability
props: C no / I no (assumed at destination) / A no (assumed) / R yes compromised and selfish insiders / P no
threat: Internal nodes with legitimate identities that drop or delay packets (probability 0.2) and cooperate otherwise to raise trust; 10-50% of nodes malicious; lossy channel
overhead: Trust tables and recommendation exchange; monitoring (10 nJ/s) and overhearing (5 nJ/bit) energy; no cryptography
limitations: Energy and throughput compared qualitatively; raw throughput lower than both baselines; assumes rational attackers

scheme: BS-SCRM: whale-optimization CH election with blockchain record (also in the metaheuristic family table)
mechanism: Accounting nodes (main and auxiliary BS) run elite WOA; blocks store CH sets and node energies; fitness-based consensus validates blocks; sensors have view-only access
props: C claimed only (no cipher described) / I yes (tamper-evident record) / A not described / R (yes) only against tampering of the clustering result / P no
threat: Man-in-the-middle, eavesdropping, tampering and unauthorized access are named; only tampering of BS clustering results by malicious nodes is evaluated; no black-hole, Sybil or selective forwarding
overhead: Consensus messages per block, block storage, auxiliary BS nodes; none of it charged to the energy results
limitations: Fitness has no trust term, so truthfulness of energy reports is not checked; no PDR or delay; consensus cost excluded

scheme: CPDA cluster-based privacy-preserving aggregation and its cryptanalysis and repair
mechanism: Cluster leader elected with probability p_c; members split readings with random seeds and exchange encrypted slices under pre-distributed pairwise keys; leader obtains only the sum; Sen and Maitra show a seed-manipulation attack and propose an efficient and a secured variant
props: C yes (intra-cluster encryption) / I no / A no / R weak: one malicious participant breaks privacy in the original; repair resists seed manipulation but not collusion of m-1 members / P yes (individual readings hidden from the aggregator)
threat: Participants with legitimate identities (leader or member) that deviate in their choice of public seeds; colluding members; eavesdroppers
overhead: "3 + p_c" messages per node (original), "2 + p_c" (efficient variant), "5 + p_c" worst case for the secured variant, i.e. "67% more overhead in the worst case"; matrix inversion removed in the repair
evidence: A (message and operation counts; no simulation)
limitations: Additive aggregates only; privacy not resilient to collusion; no energy evaluation

scheme: DCA-SF: data-clustering detection of selective forwarding on LEACH-like clustering
mechanism: Sink clusters cumulative forwarding rates of CHs with a dynamic-parameter DBSCAN; CHs flagged for k = 5 rounds are re-checked by an inspector node inside the cluster; confirmed malicious CHs are isolated
props: C no / I no / A no / R yes compromised CHs that drop packets / P no
threat: Compromised CHs with forwarding rate in [0, 0.7] (normal [0.8, 1]); 5-25% malicious; lossy channel distinguished from attacks
overhead: One inspector node per cluster; sink-side clustering per round; detection parameters b = 3, k = 5
evidence: S (MATLAB 2014a; 300 nodes, 300 x 300; "a low missed detection rate of 1.04% and a false detection rate of 0.42%"; FND "in the 1210th round ... nearly 700 rounds later" than inspector-node monitoring)
limitations: No energy values; detection accuracy depends on thresholds; no confidentiality or authentication
